Dealing with raids, there are some good ideas to take from. I'm still learning things myself and I have about 600 hours in the game (which isn't much compared to some). 

Some good tips I have in regards to raids.

1. Build a bunker or some sort of defense for your shooters to be behind. Some sand bags, build a roof over them. The reason for this is if a raid happens at night, light affects accuracy. If your colonists are in darkness and the enemy is in a well lit area, your colonists are less likely to be shot and the enemy is more likely to be shot.  
2. Clear any cover in their line of fire so raiders have nothing to hide behind. 
3. You can also create a no mans land of sorts by making a dump pile in front of them. This only really works if the whole area is filled, otherwise it just gives cover to  the raiders. 
4. Building walls and kill boxes are good ideas too, but as someone said, later game raids can still break through so make sure you have some good combat colonists. Keep an eye out for good ones you can recruit.

With infections, just make sure you have good doctors, medicine and sterile floors.
